name: Manny Rutinel
summary:
Tonty Enmanuel Rutinel (born December 20, 1994) is an American attorney and politician who is the Representative-elect from Colorado's 8th congressional district. Previously, he served as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives for the 32nd district from 2023 to 2026.
Rutinel was the Democratic nominee for Colorado's 8th congressional district in the 2026 election, defeating incumbent Gabe Evans in the general.
